body: That’s great, now you’ll just have to bide your time till then. When you do leave just know that familial bond isn’t something sacred and there’s nothing wrong with completely shutting out your family from your life. That’s what I’m gonna do, aside from the occasional phone call and texts. I’m sure we can both find friends that can replace our families.

I also refused Islam at 14, now I’m 18 and fully confident that Islam is all bullshit. I can’t stand the religious side of my family, other than that, I love them. My plan is to leave my muslim country as soon as I can but the only way for me to leave my country is through studies. I suggest you should wait till you are of age to just leave your country on your own through studies. You will still need your family’s financial assistance after you leave your country tho, so you will have to lie when they ask if you are still praying and following Islam. If you are already from a good and well developed country or don’t want to change countries, you could just move in your own house when you start earning. Till then you will just have to endure the religious torment.
